note: Reviewed expectations for scripts/a6_native_verify.py. Raw KiCad reports are never edited; every tolerated item is listed here with its reason. Anything not listed fails the gate.

ignored_checks.description: Track endpoint not centered on via
Footprint doesn't match symbol's footprint filters
Footprint component type doesn't match footprint pads

ignored_checks_note: KiCad 10.0.8 default ignore set; the project files define no exclusions and no custom rules. A change to this set fails the gate.

drc_residuals.reason: Fixed interfaces: J3 anchor (Y60.5 world) and the upper M2 mount (Y65 world) are both frozen contracts. The overlap is between the J3 B-side courtyard and the H1 B-side screw-head courtyard; copper, holes and clearances are DRC-clean.

led_leaf.role: frozen A5 board, positive control, freshly checked

power_adapter.role: frozen A5 board, positive control, freshly checked

parity_disposition_note: Frozen A5 leaf/adapter boards name nets without the schematic's '/' sheet prefix, leave the no-connect pin D4.1 (DOUT of the last LED) without the schematic's generated 'unconnected-(...)' net name, omit the MPN field and (adapter) carry the mechanical hole H1 without a symbol. These are naming/metadata classes only: the gate separately proves pad-by-pad net equality after stripping the prefix (independent parity). The A6 controller board uses schematic net names, carries the fields and marks H1/H2 board-only, so it tolerates no parity item.
